prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable Godot UI background texture, one isolated blank paper rectangle. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: extract their layered-cut cardstock material language, do not include any creature, tree, scene or lighting background. Make a perfectly front-facing square warm bone ivory cardstock sheet with a few shallow cut layers at its edge, barely uneven crisp scissor-cut silhouette, understated paper fibers, very clean low-contrast flat ivory center occupying at least 88 percent. No folds or stains. Uniform lighting appropriate for dark readable UI text. Centered, square, narrow 2 percent transparent margin. TRUE TRANSPARENT outside the sheet, no checker pattern. Color ivory #F0E3CE. No border frame, rivets, text, icons, wood, brush strokes, torn parchment, cast shadow outside silhouette, photograph props or perspective. This is one separated blank UI art component, not a mockup.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated hollow square UI frame for Godot 9-slice stretching. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; match the sharply cut layered-cardstock paper-relief style, not the characters or forest. A thin squared flat front-facing frame made of 3 stacked narrow cardstock rails: charcoal #27231F main rail, warm ochre #BD7D32 secondary thin inset, bone ivory fine cut lip. Visible shallow offset layer no thicker than 5 pixels at display scale. Simple gently hand-cut contour, square corners, same straight thickness on all four sides. Frame rails take ONLY outer 6 percent of square; large empty center. Absolutely TRUE TRANSPARENT center hole and outside. No sheet filling center. No text, symbols, rivets, clips, ornaments, wood grain, scratched paint, rounded filigree, strong bevel, realistic metal, background, floor, perspective or vignettes. UI-ready separated empty frame, not a scene or mockup.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable isolated blank button plaque for Godot UI. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: use their layered scissor-cut paper-relief aesthetic and color, no monsters or trees. A flat front-facing horizontal rectangle width-to-height 3:1, squared subtly uneven cut corners, centered on true transparent background with narrow margin. Main warm ochre #BD7D32 card, with two thin offset charcoal #27231F and rust copper #94513F paper underlayers peeking at bottom and right. Very subtle paper grain. Large unmarked consistent flat light ochre center suitable for dark UI text. Layer thickness small. No text, icons, outlines drawn in ink, rivets, clip, perspective, glossy highlights, wood grain, paint-brush silhouette, decorative holes, folds, strong cast shadows or checker pattern. This is only one blank 9-slice scalable UI button art piece, not a complete interface.
